# Lexora (uniappx.in)

> Lexora is a multi-tenant smart library and seat management SaaS. Institutions manage branches, libraries, seats, QR attendance, books, members, subscriptions, billing, and analytics from one platform.

Site: https://uniappx.in
API: https://apiuniappx.runasp.net/api/v1
Support: support@uniappx.in

## Product summary

Lexora helps reading rooms, coaching libraries, and multi-branch institutions run day-to-day library operations: seat layouts and shifts, member check-in via QR, book catalog circulation, subscription billing, and real-time occupancy/revenue analytics. The product is multi-tenant with institution → branch → library hierarchy.

## Common questions

### What is Lexora?
Lexora is a cloud platform for smart library and seat management with multi-branch support, QR attendance, book circulation, and billing.

### Who is it for?
Reading rooms, coaching libraries, college libraries, and institutions that need seat allocation, attendance, members, and analytics.

### Does it support multiple branches?
Yes. Lexora models institution, branch, and library scopes with tenant isolation.

### How does attendance work?
Members scan library or member QR codes; Lexora records check-in/out and links attendance to seats and profiles.
